feature_queries.name: review_recency_and_counts
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time,
    r.product_id,
    r.rating,
    r.verified
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND r.review_time < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  timestamp,
  COALESCE(COUNT(review_time),0) AS reviews_cnt_all,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT product_id),0) AS products_cnt_all,
  COALESCE(AVG(rating),0.0) AS rating_mean_all,
  COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(rating),0.0) AS rating_std_all,
  COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN verified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0.0) AS verified_rate_all,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(review_time), timestamp), 9999) AS days_since_last_review,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'),0) AS reviews_cnt_7d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0) AS reviews_cnt_30d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS reviews_cnt_90d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days'),0) AS reviews_cnt_180d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS reviews_cnt_365d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0) AS products_cnt_30d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS products_cnt_90d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS products_cnt_365d
FROM base
GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: price_aggregates
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time,
    p.price
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND r.review_time < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON p.product_id = r.product_id
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  timestamp,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)),0.0) AS hist_price_sum_all,
  COALESCE(AVG(price),0.0) AS hist_price_mean_all,
  COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(price),0.0) AS hist_price_std_all,
  COALESCE(QUANTILE_CONT(price, 0.5),0.0) AS hist_price_median_all,
  COALESCE(QUANTILE_CONT(price, 0.9),0.0) AS hist_price_p90_all,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0.0) AS hist_price_sum_30d,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0.0) AS hist_price_sum_90d,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days'),0.0) AS hist_price_sum_180d,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0.0) AS hist_price_sum_365d,
  COALESCE(AVG(price) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0.0) AS hist_price_mean_90d
FROM base
GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: brand_category_mix_extended
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time,
    p.brand,
    p.category
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND r.review_time < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON p.product_id = r.product_id
),
cat AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    review_time,
    brand,
    category,
    CASE WHEN category IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cat_null,
    CASE WHEN category IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_LENGTH(category) >= 1 THEN category[1] ELSE NULL END AS cat1,
    CASE WHEN category IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_LENGTH(category) >= 2 THEN category[2] ELSE NULL END AS cat2,
    CASE WHEN category IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_LENGTH(category) >= 3 THEN category[3] ELSE NULL END AS cat3
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  timestamp,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT brand),0) AS distinct_brands_all,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT brand) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS distinct_brands_365d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT brand) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS distinct_brands_90d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cat1),0) AS distinct_cat1_all,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cat1) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS distinct_cat1_365d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cat1) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS distinct_cat1_90d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cat2),0) AS distinct_cat2_all,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cat2) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS distinct_cat2_365d,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cat3),0) AS distinct_cat3_all,
  COALESCE(AVG(cat_null),0.0) AS frac_cat_null_all,
  COALESCE(AVG(cat_null) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0.0) AS frac_cat_null_365d
FROM cat
GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: derived_ratios_and_momentum
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time,
    p.price
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.customer_id = e.customer_id
   AND r.review_time < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN product p
    ON p.product_id = r.product_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0) AS reviews_30d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS reviews_90d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days'),0) AS reviews_180d,
    COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS reviews_365d,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0.0) AS price_30d,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0.0) AS price_90d,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days'),0.0) AS price_180d,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(price,0.0)) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0.0) AS price_365d
  FROM base
  GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  timestamp,
  reviews_30d * 1.0 / 30.0 AS reviews_per_day_30d,
  reviews_90d * 1.0 / 90.0 AS reviews_per_day_90d,
  COALESCE(reviews_90d * 1.0 / NULLIF(reviews_365d,0), 0.0) AS reviews_90d_to_365d_ratio,
  COALESCE(price_30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(price_365d,0), 0.0) AS price_30d_to_365d_ratio,
  COALESCE(price_90d * 1.0 / NULLIF(price_365d,0), 0.0) AS price_90d_to_365d_ratio,
  (price_90d - price_180d * 0.5) AS price_momentum_90_vs_180,
  (reviews_90d - reviews_180d * 0.5) AS reviews_momentum_90_vs_180
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: cadence_features_last3
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND r.review_time < e.timestamp
),
ordered_365 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    review_time,
    LAG(review_time) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY review_time) AS prev_time
  FROM base
  WHERE review_time IS NOT NULL AND review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
),
gaps_365 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    review_time,
    DATE_DIFF('day', prev_time, review_time) AS gap_days
  FROM ordered_365
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    gap_days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY review_time DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM gaps_365
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id,
  e.timestamp,
  COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_desc <= 3 THEN gap_days END), 0.0) AS mean_last3_gaps_365d,
  COALESCE(QUANTILE_CONT(CASE WHEN rn_desc <= 3 THEN gap_days END, 0.5), 0.0) AS median_last3_gaps_365d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN ranked r
  ON r.customer_id=e.customer_id AND r.timestamp=e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: cadence_features_recent_plus_ratios_and_counts
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND r.review_time < e.timestamp
),
ordered_all AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    review_time,
    LAG(review_time) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY review_time) AS prev_time
  FROM base
  WHERE review_time IS NOT NULL
),
gaps_all AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    DATE_DIFF('day', prev_time, review_time) AS gap_days
  FROM ordered_all
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
),
ordered_365 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    review_time,
    LAG(review_time) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY review_time) AS prev_time
  FROM base
  WHERE review_time IS NOT NULL AND review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
),
gaps_365 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    DATE_DIFF('day', prev_time, review_time) AS gap_days
  FROM ordered_365
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
),
last_two AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    timestamp,
    MAX(review_time) AS last_time
  FROM base
  WHERE review_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id, timestamp
),
prev_last AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    b.timestamp,
    MAX(b.review_time) AS prev_last_time
  FROM base b
  JOIN last_two l
    ON l.customer_id=b.customer_id AND l.timestamp=b.timestamp
  WHERE b.review_time IS NOT NULL AND b.review_time < l.last_time
  GROUP BY b.customer_id, b.timestamp
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(COUNT(ga.gap_days),0) AS n_gaps_all,
    COALESCE(COUNT(g365.gap_days),0) AS n_gaps_365d,
    COALESCE(AVG(ga.gap_days), 0.0) AS mean_gap_days_all,
    COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(ga.gap_days), 0.0) AS std_gap_days_all,
    COALESCE(QUANTILE_CONT(ga.gap_days, 0.5), 0.0) AS median_gap_days_all,
    COALESCE(AVG(g365.gap_days), 0.0) AS mean_gap_days_365d,
    COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(g365.gap_days), 0.0) AS std_gap_days_365d,
    COALESCE(QUANTILE_CONT(g365.gap_days, 0.5), 0.0) AS median_gap_days_365d,
    COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', p.prev_last_time, l.last_time), 0.0) AS last_gap_days
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN gaps_all ga
    ON ga.customer_id=e.customer_id AND ga.timestamp=e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN gaps_365 g365
    ON g365.customer_id=e.customer_id AND g365.timestamp=e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN last_two l
    ON l.customer_id=e.customer_id AND l.timestamp=e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN prev_last p
    ON p.customer_id=e.customer_id AND p.timestamp=e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp, p.prev_last_time, l.last_time
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  timestamp,
  n_gaps_all,
  n_gaps_365d,
  mean_gap_days_all,
  std_gap_days_all,
  median_gap_days_all,
  mean_gap_days_365d,
  std_gap_days_365d,
  median_gap_days_365d,
  last_gap_days,
  last_gap_days * 1.0 / (median_gap_days_365d + 1.0) AS last_gap_over_median_365d,
  last_gap_days * 1.0 / (mean_gap_days_365d + 1.0) AS last_gap_over_mean_365d,
  std_gap_days_365d * 1.0 / (mean_gap_days_365d + 1.0) AS std_over_mean_gap_365d
FROM agg
